verdict.rationale: HelixDB documents filtering on nodes and edges, including pre-filtering an exact candidate set before vector ranking, so query-time filtering is a first-party capability. The evidence never shows which operators are supported, so the 'rich' conditions the story asks for are unproven. Missing for 10: documented range operators, geo filters, nested AND/OR/NOT boolean logic, array-membership predicates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can express rich filter conditions (ranges, geo, nested boolean logic, array membership) in queries

citations.quote: Search and filtering on both nodes and edges, not just nodes.
traverse and filter an exact candidate set before vector ranking, so results cannot escape graph or permission boundaries.
